resources.string: Save the 4-digit mPIN you use on the LIC app. During a capture run the app can fill it in for you when the login screen appears.
Four digits, the same ones you type on the LIC login screen.
On the LIC login screen the app types the four digits and taps Login. One attempt per capture run — if it does not go through, log in yourself.
Off. The mPIN is only stored here; you type it on the LIC screen yourself.
Stored encrypted on this phone only. It is never exported, uploaded or included in a diagnostic log.
